```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 12,
  fig.height = 5
)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r paths}
project_dir <- "/home/rstudio/project"
sim_dir     <- file.path(project_dir, "data/03_simulation")
eval_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "data/04_evaluation")
prep_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "data/01_prepared")

ARM <- "reffix"
stopifnot(ARM %in% c("submitted", "reffix"))

ARM_SUFFIX <- if (ARM == "reffix") "_reffix" else ""

SIM_FILES <- if (ARM == "reffix") {
  c("Phase 1" = "reffix/all_phase1_reffix.parquet",
    "Phase 2" = "reffix/all_phase2_reffix.parquet",
    "Phase 3" = "reffix/all_phase3_reffix.parquet")
} else {
  c("Phase 1" = "phase1_covariates/all_phase1_results.parquet",
    "Phase 2" = "phase2_full_input/all_phase2_results.parquet",
    "Phase 3" = "phase3_discrete/all_phase3_results.parquet")
}

BASELINE_FILE <- if (ARM == "reffix") "baseline_cox_reffix.csv" else "baseline_cox_results.csv"

KPI_FILE <- paste0("kpi_summary", ARM_SUFFIX, ".csv")
LSR_FILE <- paste0("lsr_detail",  ARM_SUFFIX, ".csv")
FPR_FILE <- paste0("fpr_detail",  ARM_SUFFIX, ".csv")
TAB4_FILE <- paste0("tab4_threshold", ARM_SUFFIX, ".csv")

cat("アーム:", ARM, " / 出力接尾辞:", if (ARM_SUFFIX == "") "(なし)" else ARM_SUFFIX, "\n")

ALPHAS        <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10)
ALPHA_REF     <- 0.05
DATASET_ORDER <- c("lung", "pbc", "colon", "rotterdam", "flchain")
INPUT_PHASES  <- c("Phase 1", "Phase 2", "Phase 3")

PEAK_EPS_RANGE  <- c(10, 100)
PEAK_ALPHA_MULT <- 2
```

```{r load-simulation}
sim_raw <- imap_dfr(SIM_FILES, function(rel, ph) {
  read_parquet(file.path(sim_dir, rel)) %>% mutate(phase = ph)
}) %>%
  select(dataset, variable, epsilon, iteration, p_value, converged, phase)

cat("読み込み行数:", nrow(sim_raw), "\n")
sim_raw %>% count(phase) %>% kable() %>% kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

EPSILON_GRID <- sort(unique(sim_raw$epsilon))
cat("ε グリッド:", paste(ifelse(is.infinite(EPSILON_GRID), "Inf", EPSILON_GRID),
                         collapse = ", "), "\n")
stopifnot(length(EPSILON_GRID) == 15L)
```

```{r load-baseline}
baseline <- read.csv(file.path(prep_dir, BASELINE_FILE),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  select(dataset, variable, p_cox = p_value)

cat("ベースライン Cox 係数:", nrow(baseline), "行\n")
```

```{r glm-baseline}
glm_inf <- sim_raw %>%
  filter(phase == "Phase 3", is.infinite(epsilon))

glm_check <- glm_inf %>%
  group_by(dataset, variable) %>%
  summarise(n_iter = n(), n_uniq = n_distinct(round(p_value, 12)), .groups = "drop")

stopifnot(nrow(glm_check) > 0, all(glm_check$n_uniq == 1L), all(glm_check$n_iter == 1000L))
cat("ε=∞ の Phase 3 は決定的:", nrow(glm_check), "係数すべてで p 値が一意 ✅\n")

glm_baseline <- glm_inf %>%
  group_by(dataset, variable) %>%
  summarise(p_glm = unique(p_value), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r name-alignment}
sim_names <- sim_raw %>% distinct(dataset, variable)

only_baseline <- anti_join(baseline, sim_names, by = c("dataset", "variable"))
only_sim      <- anti_join(sim_names, baseline %>% select(dataset, variable),
                           by = c("dataset", "variable"))

bind_rows(
  only_baseline %>% mutate(side = "baseline のみ") %>% select(side, dataset, variable, p_cox),
  only_sim %>% mutate(side = "simulation のみ", p_cox = NA_real_) %>%
    select(side, dataset, variable, p_cox)
) %>%
  kable(caption = "係数名が一致しない行（参照レベルの違いによる）", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

EXPECTED_ONLY_BASELINE <- if (ARM == "reffix") {
  character(0)
} else {
  c("pbc sexf", "colon rxLev")
}

stopifnot(
  nrow(only_baseline) == length(EXPECTED_ONLY_BASELINE),
  setequal(paste(only_baseline$dataset, only_baseline$variable), EXPECTED_ONLY_BASELINE),
  all(only_baseline$p_cox > max(ALPHAS))
)
if (length(EXPECTED_ONLY_BASELINE) == 0L) {
  cat("アーム", ARM, ": ベースラインのみに現れる係数は 0 件 ✅（参照水準の食い違いが解消）\n")
} else {
  cat("不一致", nrow(only_baseline), "係数はいずれも p >", max(ALPHAS), "→ 全 α で非有意側 ✅\n")
}

EXPECTED_ONLY_SIM <- if (ARM == "reffix") {
  character(0)
} else {
  c("pbc sexm", "colon rxObs")
}
stopifnot(
  nrow(only_sim) == length(EXPECTED_ONLY_SIM),
  setequal(paste(only_sim$dataset, only_sim$variable), EXPECTED_ONLY_SIM)
)

baseline_used <- baseline %>% semi_join(sim_names, by = c("dataset", "variable"))
cat("分母の母集団（照合可能なベースライン係数）:", nrow(baseline_used), "行\n")
```

```{r exclusion-sets}
discord <- inner_join(baseline, glm_baseline, by = c("dataset", "variable"))
cat("Cox / GLM の両方で p 値が得られる係数:", nrow(discord), "行\n")

exclusions <- map_dfr(ALPHAS, function(a) {
  bind_rows(
    discord %>% filter(p_cox <  a, p_glm >= a) %>% mutate(kind = "LSR_EXCLUDE"),
    discord %>% filter(p_cox >= a, p_glm <  a) %>% mutate(kind = "FPR_EXCLUDE")
  ) %>%
    mutate(alpha = a) %>%
    select(alpha, kind, dataset, variable, p_cox, p_glm)
})

exclusions %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  arrange(alpha, kind, dataset) %>%
  kable(caption = "α ごとに再判定した Phase 3 の除外集合（Cox と離散時間 GLM で有意性が食い違う係数）",
        digits = 5) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows(index = table(paste0("α = ", format(exclusions$alpha, nsmall = 2))))

ex05_lsr <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == ALPHA_REF, kind == "LSR_EXCLUDE")
ex05_fpr <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == ALPHA_REF, kind == "FPR_EXCLUDE")

if (ARM == "reffix") {
  ex_ref <- read.csv(file.path(eval_dir, "phase3_exclusions_reffix.csv"),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  ref_lsr <- ex_ref %>% filter(kind == "lsr")
  ref_fpr <- ex_ref %>% filter(kind == "fpr")
  stopifnot(
    nrow(ex_ref) == 3L,
    nrow(ref_lsr) == 2L, nrow(ref_fpr) == 1L,
    nrow(ex05_lsr) == nrow(ref_lsr),
    nrow(ex05_fpr) == nrow(ref_fpr),
    setequal(paste(ex05_lsr$dataset, ex05_lsr$variable),
             paste(ref_lsr$dataset, ref_lsr$variable)),
    setequal(paste(ex05_fpr$dataset, ex05_fpr$variable),
             paste(ref_fpr$dataset, ref_fpr$variable))
  )
  cat("α=0.05 の除外集合は phase3_exclusions_reffix.csv と一致 ✅\n")
} else {
  stopifnot(
    nrow(ex05_lsr) == 2L,
    setequal(paste(ex05_lsr$dataset, ex05_lsr$variable), c("lung ph.karno", "flchain sample.yr")),
    nrow(ex05_fpr) == 1L,
    ex05_fpr$dataset == "flchain", ex05_fpr$variable == "kappa"
  )
  cat("α=0.05 の除外集合は evaluation.Rmd のハードコード値と一致 ✅\n")
}
```

```{r denominators}
classify <- map_dfr(ALPHAS, function(a) {
  sig  <- baseline_used %>% filter(p_cox <  a) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  nsig <- baseline_used %>% filter(p_cox >= a) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  lex  <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == a, kind == "LSR_EXCLUDE") %>% select(dataset, variable)
  fex  <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == a, kind == "FPR_EXCLUDE") %>% select(dataset, variable)

  expand_grid(dataset = DATASET_ORDER, phase = INPUT_PHASES) %>%
    mutate(
      alpha = a,
      n_sig_coef    = map2_int(dataset, phase, function(ds, ph) {
        s <- sig %>% filter(dataset == ds)
        if (ph == "Phase 3") s <- s %>% anti_join(lex, by = c("dataset", "variable"))
        nrow(s)
      }),
      n_nonsig_coef = map2_int(dataset, phase, function(ds, ph) {
        s <- nsig %>% filter(dataset == ds)
        if (ph == "Phase 3") s <- s %>% anti_join(fex, by = c("dataset", "variable"))
        nrow(s)
      })
    ) %>%
    select(alpha, dataset, phase, n_sig_coef, n_nonsig_coef)
})

classify %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  arrange(alpha, dataset, phase) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha, values_from = c(n_sig_coef, n_nonsig_coef)) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("α 別の分母サイズ。n_sig = LSR の分母（ベースライン有意な Cox 係数の数）、",
                        "n_nonsig = FPR の分母（ベースライン非有意な Cox 係数の数）。",
                        "Phase 3 は Cox/GLM 乖離係数を除外した後の値。")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

empty_denom <- classify %>% filter(n_sig_coef == 0 | n_nonsig_coef == 0)
cat("分母が 0 になる dataset × phase × α の組:", nrow(empty_denom), "件\n")
if (nrow(empty_denom) > 0) {
  empty_denom %>% kable(caption = "分母が空の組（該当指標は NA とする）") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>% print()
}

small_denom <- classify %>%
  filter(n_sig_coef <= 3 | n_nonsig_coef <= 3) %>%
  mutate(
    lsr_step = ifelse(n_sig_coef > 0, 1 / n_sig_coef, NA_real_),
    fpr_step = ifelse(n_nonsig_coef > 0, 1 / n_nonsig_coef, NA_real_)
  )
small_denom %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  arrange(alpha, dataset, phase) %>%
  kable(caption = "分母が 3 以下の組。平均 LSR / FPR の刻み幅（1/分母）を併記する。",
        digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r compute-metrics}
compute_for_alpha <- function(a) {
  sig  <- baseline_used %>% filter(p_cox <  a) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  nsig <- baseline_used %>% filter(p_cox >= a) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  lex  <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == a, kind == "LSR_EXCLUDE") %>%
    select(dataset, variable) %>% mutate(phase = "Phase 3")
  fex  <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == a, kind == "FPR_EXCLUDE") %>%
    select(dataset, variable) %>% mutate(phase = "Phase 3")

  conv <- sim_raw %>% filter(converged)

  lsr <- conv %>%
    inner_join(sig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    anti_join(lex, by = c("dataset", "variable", "phase")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, phase, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(n_sims = n(), n_na = sum(is.na(p_value)),
              n_lost = sum(p_value >= a), lsr = n_lost / n_sims, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(alpha = a)

  fpr <- conv %>%
    inner_join(nsig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    anti_join(fex, by = c("dataset", "variable", "phase")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, phase, epsilon, variable) %>%
    summarise(n_sims = n(), n_na = sum(is.na(p_value)),
              n_false_pos = sum(p_value < a), fpr = n_false_pos / n_sims, .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(alpha = a)

  list(lsr = lsr, fpr = fpr)
}

metrics <- map(ALPHAS, compute_for_alpha)
lsr_var <- map_dfr(metrics, "lsr")
fpr_var <- map_dfr(metrics, "fpr")

cat("係数レベル LSR 行数:", nrow(lsr_var), " / FPR 行数:", nrow(fpr_var), "\n")
```

```{r verify-rows}
lsr_rows_actual <- lsr_var %>% count(alpha, name = "lsr_rows")
fpr_rows_actual <- fpr_var %>% count(alpha, name = "fpr_rows")

rows_cmp <- EXPECTED_ROWS %>%
  rename(exp_lsr = lsr_rows, exp_fpr = fpr_rows) %>%
  left_join(lsr_rows_actual, by = "alpha") %>%
  left_join(fpr_rows_actual, by = "alpha")

rows_cmp %>%
  kable(caption = "期待行数 vs 実際の行数") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

stopifnot(
  nrow(rows_cmp) == length(ALPHAS),
  !anyNA(rows_cmp$lsr_rows), !anyNA(rows_cmp$fpr_rows),
  identical(as.integer(rows_cmp$lsr_rows), as.integer(rows_cmp$exp_lsr)),
  identical(as.integer(rows_cmp$fpr_rows), as.integer(rows_cmp$exp_fpr))
)

n_sims_all <- c(lsr_var$n_sims, fpr_var$n_sims)
cat("n_sims の範囲:", min(n_sims_all), "-", max(n_sims_all),
    "（1000 未満のセル:", sum(n_sims_all < 1000L), "/", length(n_sims_all), "）\n")

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(lsr_var$lsr), !anyNA(fpr_var$fpr),
  sum(lsr_var$n_na) == 0L, sum(fpr_var$n_na) == 0L,
  min(n_sims_all) >= 990L, max(n_sims_all) == 1000L,
  all(lsr_var$lsr >= 0 & lsr_var$lsr <= 1),
  all(fpr_var$fpr >= 0 & fpr_var$fpr <= 1)
)
```

```{r exact-rounding-helper}
gcd2 <- function(x, y) { while (y != 0) { t <- y; y <- x %% y; x <- t }; x }

round_exact_mean <- function(a, b, digits = 4L) {
  stopifnot(length(a) == length(b), length(a) >= 1L,
            all(b > 0), all(a >= 0), all(a <= b))
  L <- Reduce(function(x, y) x / gcd2(x, y) * y, unique(b))
  num <- sum(a * (L / b))
  den <- L * length(a)
  sc  <- 10^digits
  if (2 * num * sc + den >= 2^53) {
    stop(sprintf(paste("round_exact_mean: 共通分母が倍精度の整数表現を超えた（分母の種類 %d、lcm %.0f）。",
                       "gmp 等の有理数演算に切り替えること。"),
                 length(unique(b)), L), call. = FALSE)
  }
  floor((2 * num * sc + den) / (2 * den)) / sc
}

stopifnot(
  round_exact_mean(c(1L, 0L, 0L, 0L), rep(1000L, 4), 4L) == 0.0003,
  round_exact_mean(c(9905L), c(10000L), 3L) == 0.991,
  round_exact_mean(c(1L, 1L), c(999L, 1000L), 4L) == 0.001,
  round_exact_mean(c(0L, 0L), c(1000L, 999L), 4L) == 0,
  round_exact_mean(c(1000L, 999L), c(1000L, 999L), 4L) == 1
)
cat("順序非依存の丸め関数を検証 ✅（表示桁は DISPLAY_DIGITS =", 4L, "）\n")
cat("係数レベルの分母 n_sims の種類:",
    paste(sort(unique(c(fpr_var$n_sims, lsr_var$n_sims))), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r aggregate}
grid_all <- expand_grid(alpha = ALPHAS, dataset = DATASET_ORDER,
                        phase = INPUT_PHASES, epsilon = EPSILON_GRID)

DISPLAY_DIGITS <- 4L

lsr_avg <- lsr_var %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_lsr = mean(lsr), max_lsr = max(lsr), n_lsr_coef = n(),
            mean_lsr_r4 = round_exact_mean(n_lost, n_sims, DISPLAY_DIGITS),
            .groups = "drop")

fpr_avg <- fpr_var %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr), max_fpr = max(fpr), n_fpr_coef = n(),
            mean_fpr_r4 = round_exact_mean(n_false_pos, n_sims, DISPLAY_DIGITS),
            .groups = "drop")

alpha_summary <- grid_all %>%
  left_join(lsr_avg, by = c("alpha", "dataset", "phase", "epsilon")) %>%
  left_join(fpr_avg, by = c("alpha", "dataset", "phase", "epsilon")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_lsr_coef = replace_na(n_lsr_coef, 0L),
    n_fpr_coef = replace_na(n_fpr_coef, 0L),
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)
  ) %>%
  arrange(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon)

stopifnot(
  nrow(alpha_summary) == length(ALPHAS) * length(DATASET_ORDER) *
                          length(INPUT_PHASES) * length(EPSILON_GRID),
  !anyNA(alpha_summary$mean_lsr),
  !anyNA(alpha_summary$mean_fpr),
  !anyNA(alpha_summary$mean_lsr_r4), !anyNA(alpha_summary$mean_fpr_r4),
  max(abs(alpha_summary$mean_lsr - alpha_summary$mean_lsr_r4)) <= 0.5 * 10^-DISPLAY_DIGITS + 1e-12,
  max(abs(alpha_summary$mean_fpr - alpha_summary$mean_fpr_r4)) <= 0.5 * 10^-DISPLAY_DIGITS + 1e-12,
  max(abs(alpha_summary$mean_lsr_r4 * 10^DISPLAY_DIGITS -
          round(alpha_summary$mean_lsr_r4 * 10^DISPLAY_DIGITS))) < 1e-6,
  max(abs(alpha_summary$mean_fpr_r4 * 10^DISPLAY_DIGITS -
          round(alpha_summary$mean_fpr_r4 * 10^DISPLAY_DIGITS))) < 1e-6
)
cat("集計格子", nrow(alpha_summary), "行がすべて充足（NA なし）✅\n")

tie_count <- function(v, digits) sum(abs(v * 10^digits - (floor(v * 10^digits) + 0.5)) < 1e-7)
```

```{r monotonicity}
mono <- alpha_summary %>%
  filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  arrange(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase) %>%
  mutate(increase = mean_lsr - lag(mean_lsr)) %>%
  ungroup()

mono_summary <- mono %>%
  filter(!is.na(increase)) %>%
  group_by(alpha) %>%
  summarise(
    n_increase   = sum(increase > 0),
    max_increase = max(increase),
    min_lsr_at_increase = ifelse(any(increase > 0), min(mean_lsr[increase > 0]), NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mono_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "ε 昇順で平均 LSR が増加した箇所（α 別）", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

crossings <- map_dfr(ALPHAS, function(a) {
  map_dfr(c(0.50, 0.10), function(th) {
    base_a <- alpha_summary %>% filter(alpha == a, is.finite(epsilon))
    first_ok <- base_a %>%
      group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
      summarise(first_ok = suppressWarnings(min(epsilon[mean_lsr <= th])), .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(is.finite(first_ok))
    base_a %>%
      inner_join(first_ok, by = c("dataset", "phase")) %>%
      filter(epsilon > first_ok, mean_lsr > th) %>%
      mutate(threshold = th, alpha = a) %>%
      select(alpha, threshold, dataset, phase, first_ok, epsilon, mean_lsr)
  })
})

coverage <- map_dfr(ALPHAS, function(a) {
  map_dfr(c(0.50, 0.10), function(th) {
    base_a <- alpha_summary %>% filter(alpha == a, is.finite(epsilon))
    fo <- base_a %>%
      group_by(dataset, phase) %>%
      summarise(first_ok = suppressWarnings(min(epsilon[mean_lsr <= th])), .groups = "drop")
    tibble(alpha = a, threshold = th,
           検査対象の群 = sum(is.finite(fo$first_ok)), 全群 = nrow(fo),
           往復 = sum(crossings$alpha == a & crossings$threshold == th))
  })
})
coverage %>%
  kable(caption = "閾値ごとの検査対象の群数と往復件数（0 件が「検査していない」ではないことの証跡）") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

stopifnot(all(coverage$全群 == length(DATASET_ORDER) * length(INPUT_PHASES)),
          all(coverage$検査対象の群[coverage$threshold == 0.50] ==
                length(DATASET_ORDER) * length(INPUT_PHASES)))

    "（閾値 0.50 は 45/45 群、閾値 0.10 は",
    sum(coverage$検査対象の群[coverage$threshold == 0.10]), "/ 45 群を検査）\n")
if (nrow(crossings) > 0) {
  crossings %>%
    kable(caption = "閾値をまたぐ往復（ε* の「最小 ε」規約が壊れる組）", digits = 4) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>% print()
}

stopifnot(
  nrow(mono_summary) == length(ALPHAS),
  nrow(crossings) == 0L
)
cat("3 水準すべてで閾値をまたぐ往復は 0 件 → 「最小 ε」規約は α に依らず妥当 ✅\n")
```

```{r peak-se}
fpr_se <- map_dfr(ALPHAS, function(a) {
  fex  <- exclusions %>% filter(alpha == a, kind == "FPR_EXCLUDE") %>%
    select(dataset, variable) %>% mutate(phase = "Phase 3")
  nsig <- baseline_used %>% filter(p_cox >= a) %>% select(dataset, variable)
  sim_raw %>% filter(converged) %>%
    inner_join(nsig, by = c("dataset", "variable")) %>%
    anti_join(fex, by = c("dataset", "variable", "phase")) %>%
    group_by(dataset, phase, epsilon, iteration) %>%
    summarise(s = mean(p_value < a), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
    summarise(se_fpr = sd(s) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(alpha = a)
})
stopifnot(nrow(fpr_se) == length(ALPHAS) * length(DATASET_ORDER) *
                          length(INPUT_PHASES) * length(EPSILON_GRID),
          !anyNA(fpr_se$se_fpr))
cat("ピーク高さの標準誤差を", nrow(fpr_se), "セルで算出 ✅\n")
```

```{r peaks}
eps_finite <- EPSILON_GRID[is.finite(EPSILON_GRID)]

peaks <- alpha_summary %>%
  filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    peak_fpr   = max(mean_fpr),
    peak_eps   = min(epsilon[mean_fpr == max(mean_fpr)]),
    n_tied     = sum(mean_fpr == max(mean_fpr)),
    fpr_lo_end = mean_fpr[epsilon == min(eps_finite)],
    fpr_hi_end = mean_fpr[epsilon == max(eps_finite)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    crit_i   = peak_eps > min(eps_finite) & peak_eps < max(eps_finite) &
               fpr_lo_end < peak_fpr & fpr_hi_end < peak_fpr,
    crit_ii  = peak_fpr >= PEAK_ALPHA_MULT * alpha,
    crit_iii = peak_eps >= PEAK_EPS_RANGE[1] & peak_eps <= PEAK_EPS_RANGE[2],
    peak_over_alpha = peak_fpr / alpha,
    all_crit = crit_i & crit_ii & crit_iii
  ) %>%
  left_join(fpr_se %>% rename(se_peak = se_fpr),
            by = c("alpha", "dataset", "phase", "peak_eps" = "epsilon")) %>%
  left_join(fpr_se %>% filter(epsilon == min(eps_finite)) %>%
              select(alpha, dataset, phase, se_lo = se_fpr),
            by = c("alpha", "dataset", "phase")) %>%
  mutate(
    z_lo = (peak_fpr - fpr_lo_end) / sqrt(se_peak^2 + se_lo^2),
    z_2a = (peak_fpr - PEAK_ALPHA_MULT * alpha) / se_peak,
    z_a  = (peak_fpr - alpha) / se_peak
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(peaks$se_peak), !anyNA(peaks$se_lo))

peaks %>%
  filter(phase == "Phase 1") %>%
  select(alpha, dataset, peak_eps, peak_fpr, peak_over_alpha,
         fpr_lo_end, fpr_hi_end, crit_i, crit_ii, crit_iii, all_crit) %>%
  kable(caption = "Phase 1: FPR ピークと頑健性 3 条件の判定", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

peaks %>%
  filter(phase != "Phase 1") %>%
  select(alpha, dataset, phase, peak_eps, peak_fpr, peak_over_alpha,
         crit_i, crit_ii, crit_iii, all_crit) %>%
  kable(caption = "Phase 2 / Phase 3: FPR ピークと頑健性 3 条件の判定", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fixed-denominator}
    pull(n) %>% n_distinct() == 1L
)
cat("固定分母版の係数レベル FPR:", nrow(fpr_fixed_var), "行（期待", expected_rows_fixed, "行）✅\n")

fpr_fixed_avg <- fpr_fixed_var %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon) %>%
  summarise(mean_fpr = mean(fpr), n_fpr_coef = n(), .groups = "drop")

peaks_fixed <- fpr_fixed_avg %>%
  filter(is.finite(epsilon)) %>%
  group_by(alpha, dataset, phase) %>%
  summarise(peak_fpr = max(mean_fpr),
            peak_eps = min(epsilon[mean_fpr == max(mean_fpr)]),
            n_denom  = first(n_fpr_coef), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(peak_over_alpha = peak_fpr / alpha,
         dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  arrange(alpha, dataset, phase)

stopifnot(nrow(peaks_fixed) == length(ALPHAS) * length(DATASET_ORDER) * length(INPUT_PHASES),
          !anyNA(peaks_fixed$peak_over_alpha))

cmp_ref <- peaks %>% filter(alpha == ALPHA_REF) %>%
  select(dataset, phase, peak_fpr_var = peak_fpr, peak_eps_var = peak_eps) %>%
  mutate(dataset = factor(dataset, levels = DATASET_ORDER)) %>%
  inner_join(peaks_fixed %>% filter(alpha == ALPHA_REF) %>%
               select(dataset, phase, peak_fpr, peak_eps), by = c("dataset", "phase"))
stopifnot(
  nrow(cmp_ref) == length(DATASET_ORDER) * length(INPUT_PHASES),
  !anyNA(cmp_ref$peak_fpr),
  max(abs(cmp_ref$peak_fpr_var - cmp_ref$peak_fpr)) == 0,
  identical(cmp_ref$peak_eps_var, cmp_ref$peak_eps)
)
cat("α=0.05 では可変分母版と固定分母版が完全一致（", nrow(cmp_ref), "条件、最大絶対差 0）✅\n")
```

```{r fixed-denominator-medians}
med_cmp <- bind_rows(
  peaks %>% mutate(分母 = "α ごとに引き直す（実装どおり）") %>%
    select(分母, alpha, phase, peak_over_alpha),
  peaks_fixed %>% mutate(分母 = "α=0.05 の集合に固定") %>%
    select(分母, alpha, phase, peak_over_alpha)
)

bind_rows(
  med_cmp %>% group_by(分母, alpha) %>%
    summarise(条件数 = n(), 中央値 = median(peak_over_alpha), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(範囲 = "全 45 条件"),
  med_cmp %>% filter(phase == "Phase 1") %>% group_by(分母, alpha) %>%
    summarise(条件数 = n(), 中央値 = median(peak_over_alpha), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(範囲 = "Phase 1 のみ")
) %>%
  select(範囲, 分母, alpha, 条件数, 中央値) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha, values_from = 中央値,
              names_prefix = "α=") %>%
  kable(caption = paste("ピーク FPR / α の中央値。分母を固定すると 45 条件では単調な傾向が消え、",
                        "Phase 1 では向きは残るが傾きが縮む。"),
        digits = 2) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)

peaks_fixed %>%
  filter(phase == "Phase 1") %>%
  select(dataset, alpha, peak_eps, peak_fpr, peak_over_alpha) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha, values_from = c(peak_eps, peak_fpr, peak_over_alpha)) %>%
  kable(caption = "固定分母版・Phase 1: ピーク位置と高さ", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r denominator-swap-evidence}
swap_cells <- alpha_summary %>%
  select(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon, mean_fpr) %>%
  mutate(alpha_key = sprintf("%.2f", alpha)) %>%
  select(-alpha) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha_key, values_from = mean_fpr) %>%
  mutate(drop_01_05 = `0.05` < `0.01`, drop_05_10 = `0.10` < `0.05`)

stopifnot(nrow(swap_cells) == length(DATASET_ORDER) * length(INPUT_PHASES) * length(EPSILON_GRID),
          !anyNA(swap_cells$`0.01`), !anyNA(swap_cells$`0.05`), !anyNA(swap_cells$`0.10`))

n_drop_01_05 <- sum(swap_cells$drop_01_05)
n_drop_05_10 <- sum(swap_cells$drop_05_10)
cat(sprintf("α を緩めたのに平均 FPR が下がるセル: 0.01→0.05 で %d、0.05→0.10 で %d、計 %d（%d 行中）\n",
            n_drop_01_05, n_drop_05_10, n_drop_01_05 + n_drop_05_10, nrow(swap_cells)))

swap_fixed <- fpr_fixed_avg %>%
  mutate(alpha_key = sprintf("%.2f", alpha)) %>%
  select(alpha_key, dataset, phase, epsilon, mean_fpr) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha_key, values_from = mean_fpr)
stopifnot(nrow(swap_fixed) == nrow(swap_cells), !anyNA(swap_fixed$`0.10`))
n_drop_fixed <- sum(swap_fixed$`0.05` < swap_fixed$`0.01`) + sum(swap_fixed$`0.10` < swap_fixed$`0.05`)
stopifnot(n_drop_fixed == 0L)
cat("固定分母版で同じ現象が起きるセル:", n_drop_fixed, "件（分母を固定すれば単調）✅\n")

nonmono_peak <- peaks %>%
  select(alpha, dataset, phase, peak_fpr) %>%
  mutate(alpha_key = sprintf("%.2f", alpha)) %>% select(-alpha) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = alpha_key, values_from = peak_fpr) %>%
  filter(`0.05` < `0.01` | `0.10` < `0.05`)
cat("ピーク FPR 自体が α について単調でない条件:", nrow(nonmono_peak), "/ 15\n")
nonmono_peak %>%
  kable(caption = "ピーク FPR が α について単調でない条件（可変分母版）", digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r fpr-curves, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = epsilon, y = mean_fpr, color = alpha_lab)) +
```

```{r write-outputs}
out_files <- list(
  alpha_sensitivity_summary      = alpha_summary,
  alpha_sensitivity_lsr_detail   = lsr_var %>% select(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon, variable,
                                                      n_sims, n_lost, lsr),
  alpha_sensitivity_fpr_detail   = fpr_var %>% select(alpha, dataset, phase, epsilon, variable,
                                                      n_sims, n_false_pos, fpr),
  alpha_sensitivity_denominators = classify,
  alpha_sensitivity_exclusions   = exclusions,
  alpha_sensitivity_peaks        = peaks,
  alpha_sensitivity_eps_star     = eps_star,
  alpha_sensitivity_peaks_fixed_denom = peaks_fixed %>% mutate(dataset = as.character(dataset))
)

out_csv  <- paste0(names(out_files), ARM_SUFFIX, ".csv")
existing <- list.files(eval_dir)
stopifnot(all(startsWith(names(out_files), "alpha_sensitivity_")))
foreign <- setdiff(existing, out_csv)
stopifnot(length(intersect(out_csv, foreign)) == 0)
if (ARM == "reffix") {
  stopifnot(all(endsWith(out_csv, "_reffix.csv")),
            length(intersect(out_csv, paste0(names(out_files), ".csv"))) == 0)
}
cat("出力名の検査: 名前空間 OK / 既存ファイルとの衝突 0 件 ✅\n")

iwalk(setNames(out_files, out_csv), function(df, fn) {
  path <- file.path(eval_dir, fn)
  write.csv(df, path, row.names = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("%-42s %5d 行\n", basename(path), nrow(df)))
})
```
